title: Subscription Invoice Fetcher
summary: Matches each row of a subscription/invoice breakdown sheet to the matching invoice email in one admin Gmail inbox, saves the PDF/image attachment, and returns your sheet with a Status column and a link to the saved file next to each row. Signs in with just an email address and a Gmail App Password over IMAP.
prompt: Sign-in is rejecting valid app passwords. The likely bug: Google displays the 16-character App Password with spaces every 4 characters for readability (e.g. 'abcd efgh ijkl mnop'), but the real password has no spaces. The current code only strips leading/trailing whitespace from the app_password field, not spaces in the middle, so a copy-pasted password with its original spacing gets sent to Gmail as-is and rejected. Fix: strip ALL whitespace from the app password (not just leading/trailing) before using it to sign in. Also update the on-page help text to mention that spaces in a pasted app password are fine and will be removed automatically.
assumptions: Only spaces needed stripping from the App Password field before sign-in; the fix strips all whitespace (not just leading/trailing) so any stray tabs from a paste are removed too
The wording of the updated help text under the App Password field was not prescribed; a short plain sentence was written explaining spaces are fine and are removed automatically
No other part of sign-in, invoice search, or output changed - this was a two-line fix in app/gmail_auth.py plus a one-line help text update in templates/index.html
expects: A Gmail App Password for the admin inbox, generated from Google Account -> Security -> 2-Step Verification -> App Passwords
The invoice breakdown sheet as a real .xlsx file, with columns for enterprise/client name, a breakdown/description, an invoice date, and an amount

history.prompt: I have attached a template subscription invoice. Across every enterprise there is a breakdown against every break down i want the invoice gotten from the admin email around that date. The feature shall take admin account access and the invoice sheet and get invoices from the gmail against every break down.

Replace the current Google OAuth sign-in flow (which needs a Cloud Console app, GMAIL_CLIENT_ID/GMAIL_CLIENT_SECRET, and a redirect URI set up in advance) with a plain input field in the tool's own web page instead: an email address field and a Gmail App Password field (the 16-character password anyone can generate themselves from Google Account -> Security -> 2-Step Verification -> App Passwords, no developer setup needed). Use these two values to connect to the admin Gmail inbox over IMAP instead of the Gmail API/OAuth, and search for the invoice emails the same way as before. The app password field must be a masked password input, must never be written to disk or logged, and should only be held in memory for the current run (the user re-enters it each time they run the tool, same as they re-upload the sheet).
